videos.title: Tesla Roadster: It Drove Upside Down
videos.caption: It drove UPSIDE DOWN... then it lifted off the ground. Tesla's new Roadster doesn't use fire. Fans suck it to the road, and SpaceX cold-gas thrusters blast pure compressed air to launch it. Tesla claims 0–60 in 0.81 seconds. #Tesla #Roadster #SpaceX #Engineering
